title: How Unity powers their workloads on Google Kubernetes Engine
description: Join this session to discover how Unity, one of the world's top video game software developer, runs their deployment on Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) on Google Cloud. In this fireside chat, we will go through this evolution journey together highlighting key milestones and best practices so that you too can run your enterprise deployment on GKE.
